title: 第10章 《五十万颗心的碰撞——我们这些工农兵大学生啊》
content_zh:
刘济民脑袋晕乎乎的，不知道这位老师到底是什么意思。刘济民刚打开宿舍门，就被老师给推了进去，还反手将宿舍门给插上了。

    “老师，你这？”刘济民忍不住问道。

    老师继续苦口婆心地说道：“济民同学啊，我看过你的资料。以二等功被部队推荐上大学，勇救落水儿童，一看就是心胸宽广的年轻人。国家啊，正需要你们这群青年人做建设。你的学习成绩也不错，回到部队是大有作为啊！”

    我的成绩还不错？

    刘济民嘴角忍不住抽了一下，睁眼说瞎话折寿啊

    “老师，您是？”

    “哦....忘了介绍了，我叫王炳文，刚从地方上回来，担任新生的辅导员。济民同学，早上食堂发生的事情，我已经严厉批评过那些学生了，是他们做的不对。但是，他们毕竟还年轻，得给他们一次机会！”

    王炳文年过四旬，刚恢复工作。食堂发生的事情，一下子就戳中了他最敏感的神经。

    有些事不上秤没有四两，上了秤一千斤也打不住。

    77级学生刚入校，就发生了如此冲突，这在全国是第一例。这也意味着，一旦闹大了，挨的板子也最重。

    他听了学生们关于食堂事件的一些细节，想到这些帽子扣下来，就算是校长也得头疼。

    因此，他立即来宿舍蹲守，劝一劝刘济民，让他不要把事情闹大。

    “王老师，你这话就不对了。你不能和稀泥啊，这事儿是他们不对在先。您应该也知道，两方本来心里就敏感，他们不是找茬吗？”刘济民义愤填膺地说道。

    王炳文老师擦了擦额头的汗：“对对对，是他们的错！济民同学，你是他们的师兄，你看这大字报，就别贴了！”

    “王老师，行，也就是您来说情，看在您的面子上，我就不贴了！”稿纸拿去贴大字报，刘济民还舍不得呢！

    “真的？”刘济民如此爽快，倒是让王炳文有些不相信。毕竟能说出那些话，足以说明刘济民这家伙不是省油的灯啊！

    看刘济民光明磊落的眼神，王炳文又觉得这孩子不像开帽子工厂的。

    “济民同学，有事情记得来找我，一定来找我啊！”说完，老头拍了拍刘济民的肩膀，哆哆嗦嗦地走了，一步三回头，生怕刘济民反悔。
content_en:
Liu Jimin's head was dizzy and he didn't know what the teacher meant. As soon as Liu Jimin opened the dormitory door, the teacher pushed him in and locked the dormitory door with his backhand.

    "Teacher, what about you?" Liu Jimin couldn't help but ask.

    The teacher continued to say earnestly: "Classmate Jimin, I have read your information. You were recommended to go to college by the army for your second-class merit, and you bravely rescued children who fell into the water. You can tell that you are a young man with a broad mind. The country needs young people like you for construction. Your academic performance is also good. You will have a lot of potential when you return to the army!"

    My grades are not bad?

    Liu Jimin couldn't help but twitch the corner of his mouth. He opened his eyes and told lies and his life would be shortened.

    "Teacher, who are you?"

    "Oh...I forgot to introduce you. My name is Wang Bingwen. I just came back from the local area and serve as a counselor for freshmen. Classmate Jimin, I have severely criticized those students for what happened in the cafeteria this morning. They did something wrong. However, they are still young after all, so we have to give them a chance!"

    Wang Bingwen is over 40 years old and has just resumed work. What happened in the cafeteria immediately touched his most sensitive nerve.

    Some things don't weigh four ounces if they don't go on the scale, and they can't stop even if they weigh a thousand kilograms.

    This is the first time in the country that such a conflict occurred when students from the Class of 1977 entered the school. This also means that once it gets too big, the consequences will be the most severe.

    He heard some details about the incident in the cafeteria from the students, and even the principal would have a headache if these hats were slapped on his head.

    Therefore, he immediately came to the dormitory and advised Liu Jimin not to make the matter a big deal.

    "Teacher Wang, what you said is wrong. You can't make peace with each other. It was their fault in the first place. You should also know that the two parties are already sensitive, aren't they looking for trouble?" Liu Jimin said angrily.

    Teacher Wang Bingwen wiped the sweat from his forehead: "Yes, yes, it's their fault! Classmate Jimin, you are their senior brother. If you look at this big-character poster, stop posting it!"

    "Teacher Wang, okay, you are here to intercede. For your sake, I won't post it!" Liu Jimin couldn't bear to part with the manuscript paper to put up a big-character poster!

    "Really?" Liu Jimin was so cheerful that Wang Bingwen didn't believe it. After all, being able to say those words is enough to show that Liu Jimin is not a fuel-efficient guy!

    Looking at Liu Jimin's upright eyes, Wang Bingwen felt that this kid didn't look like someone who ran a hat factory.

    "Classmate Jimin, remember to come to me if you have anything to do. You must come to me!" After saying that, the old man patted Liu Jimin on the shoulder and walked away tremblingly, looking back three times for fear that Liu Jimin would regret it.
title_en: Chapter 10 "The Collision of Half a Thousand Hearts - We Workers, Peasants, Soldiers and College Students"
